You go to service tunnel A2 and disable the regulators.|Neeku Vozo and Kazuda Xiono|}} '''Service tunnel A2''' was a location in the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. During the station's [[Hunt for the Colossus|flight]] from the [[First Order]], [[Neeku Vozo]] and [[Nenavakasa Nalor]] conducted some repairs in the tunnel. Nalor, having grown to like Vozo, attempted to admit to him there that she was in fact a [[saboteur]] hired by the First Order, but reconsidered. After Nalor's [[Sabotage of the Colossus|sabotage]] was uncovered and she fled the ''Colossus'', Vozo sent [[Kazuda Xiono]] to the service tunnel to undo some of Nalor's "repairs" so the station could move again. {{Loc-stub}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of service tunnel A2}} *{{Resistance|The Engineer}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Colossus locations]]
